title: project migrate
description: The answer of nw-designer project migrate [<name>] [--dry-run]: every design of one project brought up one level, to the forms this build writes (ADR-S16), or what it would do. A file two or more levels older, newer, or unreadable is refused and nothing is written.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/designer/app/v2: the form of designer's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the files they describe.

kind.description: Always ProjectMigrate, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

source.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always designer, the product ID of the app that gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v2, the contract version this schema belongs to.

data.description: One entry per design of the project, in the order they were migrated, so a reader sees what each step did or would do in each design.

items.description: One design: its id, and what each step of the migration (design files, links, layout, in that order) found or did in it.

design.description: The design, by its id, so a project with several designs says whose files changed.

designFiles.description: The design files step: each resource file and definitions.yml brought from design/v2 to design/v3 (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), each file rewritten whole where it stands, with its old style fields moved to styles, colours and rules; or why there was nothing to do.

nothing.description: Why this step had nothing to do, in words for people: every file of the design is already design/v3; present only then, and then moves is empty and steps absent.

moves.description: Each file the step rewrites, in the order it works through them.

from.description: The file in design/v2, by its path inside the design's folder.

to.description: The file in design/v3, by its path inside the design's folder; always the same path, as the step rewrites each file where it stands.

steps.description: Each command the step ran, in order; present only on a real run, never on --dry-run, so a reader sees where a run stopped.

links.description: The links step: each Connection file moved to link/ as a Link, and definitions.yml and design.yml rewritten where they say an old line word; or why there was nothing to do.

nothing.description: Why this step had nothing to do, in words for people; present only then, and then moves is empty and steps absent.

moves.description: Each file the step moves, rewrites or drops, in the order it works through them.

items.description: One file and where it goes.

from.description: The file before the step, by its path inside the design's folder.

to.description: The file after the step, by its path inside the design's folder; the same path when the file is rewritten where it stands.

says.description: Why the file is dropped rather than moved, in words for people; absent for a file that is moved or rewritten.

steps.description: Each command the step ran, in order; present only on a real run, never on --dry-run, so a reader sees where a run stopped.

layout.description: The layout step: layout.yml brought from layout/v1 to layout/v2 (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), every box each view draws given a place, and every Group file's size taken out; or why there was nothing to do.

nothing.description: Why this step had nothing to do, in words for people: layout.yml is already layout/v2 and no Group file carries a size; present only then, and then nothing else but groups.

groups.description: How many Group files lose the size they carried, which only layout.yml keeps.

placed.description: What the step gave a place, one entry per view that had a box without one; absent when every box already had one.

items.description: The boxes of one view given a place, worked out once by the same rule a write uses.

view.description: The view, by its name in design.yml, so a reader shows each view's new places apart.

boxes.description: The boxes and groups placed in the view's rows, by id, in id order, so a person sees which got a place.

hexagon.description: The blocks placed on the view's hexagon, by id, in id order; always empty when the view draws no hexagon.

steps.description: Each command the step ran, in order; present only on a real run, never on --dry-run, so a reader sees where a run stopped.

tidied.description: What tidying each view's lines did, one entry per view, when the person also asked for the lines to be tidied; absent otherwise.
